pages.text: $(l)Essentia Delivery Issues$()$(li)Set XNet output hatches to priority 1200 (highest) to ensure reliable essentia delivery and reduce connector points for better performance.
$(li)Essentia mirrors may fail to recognize new jars if placed on a block previously used for mirrors; avoid reusing such blocks or place mirrors on new blocks.

$(l)Rift & Taint Behavior$()$(li)The Void Siphon does not close rifts—it intentionally leaves them open for farming; a small rift is normal and not a bug.$(li)When Flux Rifts collapse (from starvation or leeching), they commonly spawn taint seeds nearby;
these are highly visible and can be removed by killing the seed.

$(l)Efficiency & Setup Tips$()$(li)The carminite empowerer export bus stops automatically when full; better practice is to passive-export crystals or use a recipe that consumes the exact number of crystals and melt on-site.
$(li)Torcherino DML Sim Chambers to speed up processing; 5 chambers are sufficient for essentia farms, and most don’t need to run constantly.
